proof_body:
by
  intro F _ _ K u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ hK h₁ h₂ m₁ m₂
  have key : ∀ (u v : F), v ∈ K → (∀ w ∈ K, ‖u - v‖ ≤ ‖u - w‖) → ∀ w ∈ K, inner ℝ (u - v) (w - v) ≤ 0 := by
    intro u v hv hm
    haveI : Nonempty K := ⟨⟨v, hv⟩⟩
    have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun w : K => ‖u - w‖) := ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _⟩
    exact (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hK hv).mp
      (le_antisymm (le_ciInf fun w => hm w w.2) (ciInf_le hbdd ⟨v, hv⟩))
  have a1 := key u₁ v₁ h₁ m₁ v₂ h₂
  have a2 := key u₂ v₂ h₂ m₂ v₁ h₁
  have a3 : ‖v₁ - v₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (u₁ - u₂) (v₁ - v₂) := by
    have e1 : inner ℝ (u₁ - v₁) (v₂ - v₁) + inner ℝ (u₂ - v₂) (v₁ - v₂) = inner ℝ (v₁ - v₂) (v₁ - v₂) - inner ℝ (u₁ - u₂) (v₁ - v₂) := by
      simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right]; ring
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at e1
    linarith
  have a4 := real_inner_le_norm (u₁ - u₂) (v₁ - v₂)
  by_cases h0 : ‖v₁ - v₂‖ = 0
  · rw [h0]; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hp : 0 < ‖v₁ - v₂‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm h0)
  have : ‖v₁ - v₂‖ * ‖v₁ - v₂‖ ≤ ‖u₁ - u₂‖ * ‖v₁ - v₂‖ := by nlinarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right this hp
target_source: ∀ (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (K : Set F) (u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : F), Convex ℝ K → v₁ ∈ K → v₂ ∈ K → (∀ w ∈ K, ‖u₁ - v₁‖ ≤ ‖u₁ - w‖) → (∀ w ∈ K, ‖u₂ - v₂‖ ≤ ‖u₂ - w‖) → ‖v₁ - v₂‖ ≤ ‖u₁ - u₂‖
